svg.title: Open890RC overview
svg.desc: The TS-890S is connected by LAN cable to a computer running the Open890RC server: a PC, a mini PC or simply a Raspberry Pi. The server provides a central web interface for all clients. Browsers on laptops, PCs and phones use it over LAN, Wi-Fi or the internet with HTTPS and WebSocket. An optional SPE Expert amplifier is connected to the server computer by a serial cable.
svg.text: Web remote control for the Kenwood TS-890S
PC, Mini PC or simply a Raspberry Pi
